scope: Four servings. Uses trimmed lean pork loin, 600 g cooked white rice (150 g per serving), and the named local sauce and Fineli records. Every listed marinade and brushing ingredient is conservatively counted as fully retained; this may overstate sauce actually eaten. Five-spice is excluded under its written omission bound. Practical estimate, not laboratory analysis.
